[[Jishol Darksong]] is a [[Cobalt]] [[boss]] that spawns in [[Resplendent Makuun]]. He is usually found in the company of four other Cobalts.

==Locations==

** {{NPC location|Resplendent Makuun}}

* {{skill icon|Chorus of Restoration}}
* {{skill icon|Leader's Comfort}}
* {{skill icon|Song of Power}}
* {{skill icon|Song of Purification}} ([[elite]])

==Items dropped==
* [[Cobalt Talon]]
* [[Half-Digested Armor]]
* [[The Darksong]] ([[unique]])

==Notes==
* This boss will not appear in [[Resplendent Makuun]] during the quest [[The Search for Survivors]].
* Even though he is a [[Paragon]], he attacks in melee.
